Name: bezajel's Vanilla Nari Portrait
Author: bezajel
Description:
I needed a vanilla-sizes portrait for reque's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18830]Custom NPC Nari[/url], so I drew them. She's a fun (and also useful) NPC, so I recommend giving her a whirl.

My portraits are based partly on Nari's original HD portraits, and partly on the portrait notes accompanying the dialogue files.

The [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18830]original mod page[/url]﻿ has the original Korean version and Chinese translation, and I also have an [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33181]English translation and 1.6 update[/url]. There is another translation out there but I recommend mine instead for reasons not entirely related to ego.


[i][size=4]There is a CP version and a PNG replacement version of this mod.
Please pay attention to the requirements and installation instructions for each, as they are different.[/size][/i]


[b][size=5]Requirements[/size]
[/b]

[size=3]For the [/size][u]CP version:
[/u][size=2]
[/size][list]
[*][size=2]Stardew Valley 1.6 - (designed and tested on 1.6.14)[/size]
[*][size=2][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿  - (designed and tested on 4.2.1)[/size]
[*][size=2][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ - ﻿(designed and tested on 1.6.1)[/size]
[*][size=2][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18830]Custom NPC Nari[/url]﻿ 1.1.0 (Korean or Chinese version - tested with Korean)[/size]
[*][size=2](Optional but recommended): [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33181]English translation and 1.6 update[/url]﻿ (version 1.0.0)[/size]
[/list]
[size=3]For the [u]PNG replacement version[/u]:

[/size][size=2][list]
[*]Stardew Valley
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18830]Custom NPC Nari[/url]﻿ (Korean or Chinese version)
[*][size=2](Optional but recommended): [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33181]English translation and 1.6 update[/url]﻿ ﻿[/size](non-update version also available)
[/list]
for the PNG replacement, you can use any version of the above that works for you. Or none of them if you just want a nice iPhone background..?[/size]



[size=5][b]Installation Instructions
[/b][/size]

[size=3][u]CP version:[/u][/size]

[list=1]
[*]Install all the prerequisite mods according to their instructions.
[*]Download and extract (unzip) the CP version of this mod.
[*]Move the Folder '﻿[CP] bezajel's Nari Vanilla Portrait' to your Mods folder.
[*]﻿All done! - now when you use the original mod + this mod, the new vanilla style portrait will be shown.
[/list]

[u][size=3]PNG replacement version:
[/size][/u]
[list=1]
[*]Install all the prerequisite mods according to their instructions.
[*]Locate the original (Korean or Chinese) mod in your Mods folder - it should be named '﻿[CP] Nari', or it could be in a containing folder named '﻿Custom NPC Nari'
[*]Open the 'portraits' folder in the original mod and locate the 'Nari.png' file within it. This is the original HD portrait you are replacing. Rename or save a copy of this file if you think you will want to use it later.
[*]Download and extract (unzip) the PNG replacement version of this mod. You should now have a folder containing the new vanilla portrait, named 'Nari.png'.
[*]Move (or copy and paste) 'Nari.png' from [u]this mod[/u], into the 'portraits' folder of the original mod. You can overwrite the existing file if asked.
[*]All done! - now when you use the original mod, the new vanilla style portrait will be shown.
[/list]
